about: revmoves3 (2026-11-21, the move audit's follow-up): Wrath (0x036F, Revenge import, slot 0, CPU) against The Rock (CPU), singles; his entry 289 -- 'revenge:1399_139b@16574' -- forced wherever the game picks a move of the same place (qa_fsub 4: the one entry). After (@424): the pin.
